name: Zenith The Future Waits
effects:
Seven single attacks (? each) capped at 19999, grants either [Attach Ice 2 with Stacking], [Attach Water 2 with Stacking], or [Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking], grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and Zenith Mode: Lulu to user, grants [Ice/Water/Lightning Damage +20% to user] or [MAG/MND +25% & DEF/RES +30% for 8 seconds and Quick Witch 1 to party] with at least 0/4 Witches
Zenith Mode: Lulu (Witch): Increases [Ice/Water/Lightning Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Ice, Water, or Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Lulu (Witch) after Ice, Water, or Lightning abilities (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Astra
description.text: Prevents Poison, Silence, Paralyze, Confuse, Slow, Stop, Blind, Sleep, Petrify, Berserk, Sap and Stun once
